parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Plan Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to re-derive the level plan from the current prices, forecasts and objective. There is no default. Left empty, the plan is re-derived only when the configuration changes, which means new day-ahead prices published by an already-installed source are not picked up until something else changes; the system reports that this is the case rather than leaving it to be discovered.

parameter.name: surplusForecast
parameter.label: Assemble A Surplus Forecast
parameter.description: Whether to build a forecast of future surplus for the objectives that rank on one, by netting the solar production forecast against the heating demand forecast. Off by default because no requirement defines this quantity: with no demand forecast installed the result describes production rather than surplus, and the system says so rather than presenting an upper bound as a surplus.
